component.name: Proton Security
component.summary: Check the security and health of your computer

description.p: Proton Security shows the security status of your computer at a glance, in the style of Windows Security, and lets you fix problems with one click.

ul.li: Security at a glance: antivirus, security updates, package and Flatpak updates, firewall, account protection, device security, performance and health, restore points and file backup
Virus and threat protection with ClamAV: quick, full and custom scans, quarantine, a daily automatic scan, and automatic scanning of new downloads and USB drives
Firewall: see network connections, allow or block them, and read the firewall log
Account protection: screen lock, automatic sign-in and password checks
Device security: Secure Boot, TPM and disk encryption
Performance and health: pending restarts, disk space, disk health and battery
App permissions: see and limit what Flatpak apps can access
Restore points, file backup status, and a device manager with driver actions
Alerts for new USB keyboards, network adapters and drives
For IT: a company policy file and an exportable security report

screenshot.caption: Device security with disk encryption tools

description.p: New files on the desktop and in temporary folders are checked too (programs and scripts first), recent files are checked again after virus definition updates, and you are told when a program sets itself to start automatically.
New "Add a rule" button on the Firewall page, and the Device manager no longer flickers.
Security fixes: crafted file names can no longer make a scan blame or skip the wrong file, and changes that lower protection always ask for the administrator password.
First open-source release (GPL-3.0-or-later). Safer encryption header backup, fully documented source code.
Protection history updates live with USB drive and download checks. New magenta app icon.

The tray icon now follows changes made outside the app within seconds: removing or installing ClamAV, stopping automatic security updates, turning the firewall off or on. New Power management settings link on Account protection.
The tray icon and the window now update within seconds when screen locking or sign-in settings change outside the app, such as the battery menu switch.
Administrator accounts get a neutral notice icon. Snapper and Timeshift snapshots of the home folder no longer count as a file backup.

Disk encryption tools (recovery key, change disk password, header backup), automatic USB drive scanning, visible download checks, restart reminder after 15 days with a save-your-work confirmation, bad sector reporting, and screen lock detection for the battery menu switch.
New pages: Account protection, Device security, Performance and health, App permissions. File backup status, download scanning, USB alerts, company policy file and security report.
Fits small screens such as 1366x768. Proton OS information in the menu.
Automatic security updates follows the unattended-upgrades service. Uninstall driver removes the driver from the system.
New Firewall page with connections, allow/block and the firewall log. Driver actions fixed. No background service runs as administrator.
